instruction: Configure VS Code to show line numbers in the editor.

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling line numbers in the editor. Evaluator checks if settings.json contains 'editor.lineNumbers': 'on'.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic correct: Retrieves VS Code settings.json from correct Ubuntu/Linux path (/home/user/.config/Code/User/settings.json)
Metric comparison correct: check_json_settings properly loads JSON and checks for exact key-value match of 'editor.lineNumbers': 'on'
Expected value correct: 'editor.lineNumbers': 'on' is the correct VS Code setting to enable line numbers
Complete coverage: Evaluator checks exactly what instruction requires - line numbers enabled in editor
Practical feasibility: VS Code persists settings to disk immediately when changed, no postconfig needed
Edge case handling: Metric returns 0.0 for missing files (exception handling) and missing keys (sentinel check)
